head: Actually Up is an alarm that only stops once you're out of bed
dek: Actually Up's alarm pauses for two minutes when you press Stop and ends only when you stand up; your Apple Watch can count 20 steps to prove it. It was #35 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 12 November.
details: The watch check works even with your phone in another room. It costs $0.99 with no in-app purchases, by Hemal Modi, and needs iOS 26.1.
where: iPhone with Apple Watch, App Store, $0.99
todo: Find Actually Up in the App Store and pick the Watch step check.
thumb_words: AN ALARM YOU MUST STAND UP FOR
